name: Rotate the Lead
unit: one working group of 8–16 (two parallel rounds above 12)

flow.does: Pick the real, finishable task; agree what done means
Restate, steer, one call with an owner
Make the call the task still needs

commitment: What a clean handover needs, in our own words
The call each round made, and who owns it
Where the thread wobbled — our real handover risk
Where the lead genuinely rotates in real work
debrief_prompts: Which handovers landed cleanly, and which made the team lose a beat?
Did anyone direct before restating — what did the room do about it?
Was each call visible and owned, or did it evaporate?
What did the one-call rule stop from being decided by drift?
Where does the lead genuinely rotate in your real work?
watch_outs: The task is too big to move in four minutes — shrink it first.
The real manager keeps re-taking the pen — that is the finding; give them a normal turn late.
Everyone only repeats the previous lead — require the next move as their own call.
note: No pre/post measure in this folder: the artifact is the point. Hand this spec to an agent to render a fillable sheet or a live form.
